Instant petition has been filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for quashing of Fir No.89 dated
18.05.2009 under Sections 65, 66, 66-A, 66-B, 66-C, 66-D of Information Technology Act, 2000 (for
short "It Act") and Section 420, Ipc, 1860, and Sections 65 and 66 of Right to Information Act,
2005, registered at Police Station Phase 8, S.A.S. Nagar, Punjab, Annexure P-1, alongwith all
subsequent proceedings arising therefrom, including judgment dated 25.11.2016, Annexure P-2,
passed by learned Cjm, Sas Nagar, whereby petitioner has been convicted and sentenced, on the
basis of compromise deed dated 24.02.2023, Annexure P-4.
SHEETAL 2023.09.22 16:41 | attest to the accuracy and integrity of this document Chandigarh 2023:PHHC:123156 2.
Counsel for the petitioner submits that genesis of the FIR, Annexure P-1, is a business dispute between the parties, which has been amicably settled by deed of settlement, Annexure P-4.

Counsel submits that two persons were named as accused i.e. Manjeet Singh (present petitioner) and Rohit Kapoor, who faced the trial and by judgment, Annexure P-2, he was acquitted, whereas the present petitioner was convicted for offences under the IT Act.

3. Pursuant to order dated 19.05.2023 passed by this Court, report has been received from the Additional Sessions Judge, relevant extract of which is as under:-
"Both the parties have put in appearance before this Court on 06.07.2023 for recording their statements in term of compromise arrived at between them.
The statement of appellant and Special Power of attorney of complainant Ekant Aggarwal have been recorded, who have been identified by their counsel.
Court is satisfied and compromise is genuine and without any undue influence.
SHEETAL 2023.09.22 16:41 | attest to the accuracy and integrity of this document Chandigarh 2023
Statement of Inspector/SHO Naveen Pal Singh No.450/JR, PS, Phase- 11 Mohali has been recorded.
He stated that present FIR. was registered at P.S. Phase-8 Mohali. Phase-11 came into existence later on and record was transferred to police station Phase-11 Mohali.
There were two persons arrayed as accused in this FIR namely Manjeet Singh and Rohit Kapoor.
No accused is declared as proclaimed offender.
As per police file and charge-sheet there is _ only one victim/complainant in the present case namely Mani Pal Dhariwal.
In this case two persons namely Manjeet Singh and Rohit Kapoor had been arrayed as an accused.
However, accused Rohit Kapoor was acquitted by trial Court.
AS per statement of SHO accused/appellant was not declared as a proclaimed offender in this case.
Appeal filed by appellant/convict is fixed for arguments.
This Court is_ satisfied that _ the compromise arrived at between the parties ts genuine and without any coercion or undue influence or pressure.
There is only one victim/complainant Mani Pal Dhariwal in this case."
4. Upon instructions from ASI Harnek Singh, State counsel submits that the petitioner has a clean past.
5. Counsel representing respondent No.2 does not have any objection, in case, compromise is given effect to.
6. Heard counsel for the parties.
